newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to get all IMF 1996 tranches by Dec-Cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Russia to get all IMF 1996 tranches by Dec-Cenbank.

text.p: Central Bank Chairman Sergei Dubinin predicted on Wednesday that Russia would get all the 1996 tranches a $10 billion three-year International Monetary Fund (IMF) before the end of the year.
"The final decision will be taken in December," Dubinin told a news conference. "But I remain an optimist and I think we shall get all tranches due this year."
Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, on a visit to Poland, said on Thursday that the IMF was likely to resume its loan payments from December 15.
An IMF mission left Moscow last week without taking any decision as to whether to recommend that its board pay Russia the November tranche of the loan.
The IMF delayed paying the monthly tranche in October over worries about poor Russian tax collection.
